answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The sparrow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The wharf is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the summit. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
